title: Zephyr: AddrForKey(Ed25519 pubkey) derivation
notes: Verified Zephyr/C AddrForKey acceptance as LICHEN native SHA-512 profile (not upstream yggdrasil-go bit-packing): lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519() computes 0x02 || SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7] || IID, clears IID U/L bit, rejects NULL without mutating output through lichen_yggdrasil_addr(), and binds addr[8:16] to lichen_pubkey_to_iid(). Evidence: host C CMake/CTest lichen/tests/pubkey_to_iid passed 1/1 under UBSan; Python canonical yggdrasil_address + cross-implementation vector tests passed 22/22; Rust lichen-core ipv6_address_vectors passed 4/4 and yggdrasil_addr_vectors passed 3/3, including >=10 native vectors, upstream divergence anchor, U/L-bit/binding invariants. No source edits for this bead; existing dirty address work preserved.
